<!-- markdownlint-disable -->

## Overview

Preserve tied parameter and repeated submodule names in `ModuleSource`, so native weight synchronization updates a pipeline stage's output head even when the trainer shares its embedding storage. Related to #31848.

## Claims

- Keep tied aliases in cached `metadata`, `iter_full()` and `iter_local()`.
- Preserve DTensor ownership, placements, rank membership and metadata caching.
- Cover both alias forms and iteration modes across successive updates, and document the repeated transfer/gather cost.

## Validation

Current head: `2f25de1c9d3a31160b7f2e789428f5129dd006dd`, tree `eb833d3579382cb99305773e2876cc211dabeb02`.

- **Full unchanged weight-transfer module with GPUs: 117 passed, 23 skipped.** All skips are optional Modelexpress cases because `modelexpress_rl` is absent. Both NCCL process-transfer variants and both Ray/HTTP IPC variants pass. With GPUs hidden, the same whole file gives 97 passed and 43 skipped.
- **Before fix: 4 failed, 1 passed** for `TestModuleSource`, using the unchanged PR test file and actual production imports from upstream base `fe77d0906be0c38c5e2c575cd61b545a2fa687e4`. Each failing alias case reports the missing `lm_head.weight`; all four pass in the current-head whole-module runs.
- **Current-head native NCCL A→B→A model checks pass** for TP2/PP2 packed and TP2/PP1 unpacked. Qwen3-0.6B at pinned revision `c1899de289a04d12100db370d81485cdf75e47ca`, BF16, eager FA2 and batch-invariant execution. The model's required runtime files were verified against the pinned hashes.
- Applicable hooks on all three changed paths, whitespace checks, canonical docs and standalone strict docs already passed on this unchanged head. Both rendered documentation pages have 316 valid in-page links.

| B update vs a fresh B engine | Inspected full parameter shards | Max prompt-logprob difference | Max returned token-logprob difference |
| --- | --- | ---: | ---: |
| Unmodified base, TP2/PP2 packed | Both last-stage heads remain A | 2.0645949840545654 | 2.0912771224975586 |
| Current PR, TP2/PP2 packed | Exact match | 0.0 | 0.0 |
| Current PR, TP2/PP1 unpacked | Exact match | 0.0 | 0.0 |

Initial A and restored A match cold A in all three runs. Both fixed runs match their cold controls exactly for generated IDs and every captured logprob entry. Worker PIDs and inspected storage pointers remain stable; PP1 embedding/head storage stays shared. The unpatched engine reports version B despite its stale heads. Greedy IDs happen to agree there, while shard hashes and probabilities expose the defect.

[Current-head commands, frozen scripts, raw results and independent audit](https://github.com/JiataiWang/vllm/blob/3fa2e165ebc3be80cb072ff870dd45a2b3015d44/contribution-validation/2026-11-01/pr56689/README.md). These are ordinary pytest collections with Ray installed, plus real model transfers through the native HTTP/NCCL APIs. The earlier isolated source-contract runner is superseded by this complete-module validation.

The A100-SXM4-40GB environment uses Python 3.12.16, PyTorch 2.14.0+cu130, Transformers 5.20.2 and Ray 2.56.1. Native vLLM extensions come from the official wheel at the common upstream base `fe77d0906be0c38c5e2c575cd61b545a2fa687e4`; full source manifests, frontend/worker imports, versions and native hashes are recorded. This validates the exercised Python heads with recorded binaries; no exact-source native rebuild, performance, quality or multi-node result is claimed.

Hosted CI: the [pre-run check](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/actions/runs/40978123908/job/123811114622) stops at contributor eligibility, hosted pre-commit is skipped and DCO passes. Hosted ReadtheDocs is still red; the same-head local docs results above are recorded separately. No qualifying label or review request was added.

<details>
<summary>Whole-file GPU reproduction</summary>

```bash
CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0,1,2,3,4,5,6,7 \
  VLLM_ALLOW_INSECURE_SERIALIZATION=1 RAY_TMPDIR=/tmp/vlray-repro \
  PYTHONPATH=. .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q -rs \
  tests/distributed/test_weight_transfer.py
```

The serialization opt-in matches the repository's distributed Buildkite command. A short Ray temporary path avoids Linux's Unix-socket path limit. Original startup/setup failures and the passing run's nonfatal warnings are retained in the raw logs.

</details>

## Details

PyTorch's default parameter iterator removes names that share a Parameter or registered submodule. A trainer can tie its embedding and output head while inference needs those names on different pipeline stages. Omitting the head name leaves that stage on the old weights even though synchronization reports success.

All three source enumerations now use `named_parameters(remove_duplicate=False)`, retaining the existing ownership and DTensor materialization logic. The regression stays in the existing dense `TestModuleSource` suite and uses real Torch modules and shared Parameters.

Each alias adds a transfer, and `iter_full()` may gather a tied DTensor again. Checkpoint-aware treatment of explicit output heads remains the loader's responsibility.

---

<details>
<summary> Pull Request Checklist </summary>

- [x] I used vLLM's `/pr-checklist` skill.
- [x] **Design Fit:** Reuses the current source interface and preserves ownership, caching and DTensor behavior.
- [x] **Testing and Validation:** Before/after regressions, complete CPU/GPU pytest collections and current-head model controls; optional-backend limits are explicit.
- [x] **Code Quality and Style:** Applicable hooks and rendered documentation checks pass on this head.
- [x] **Pull Request Contents:** Includes root cause, transfer cost, current evidence, source/native provenance and reproduction steps.

</details>

**BEFORE SUBMITTING, PLEASE READ <https://docs.vllm.ai/en/latest/contributing>**

files.patch:
@@ -80,8 +80,12 @@ Keep names that share a layer index (`model.layers.3.*`) contiguous in
 
 #### ModuleSource
 
-`ModuleSource(model)` covers `module.named_parameters()` when every rank holds
-the whole module. A plain tensor is owned by every rank. A `DTensor` (FSDP2, TP)
+`ModuleSource(model)` includes every parameter name, including tied aliases,
+when every rank holds the whole module. Inference workers may need these names
+on separate pipeline stages even when the trainer shares their storage. Each
+alias is transferred, and `iter_full()` may gather a tied `DTensor` more than once.
+
+A plain tensor is owned by every rank. A `DTensor` (FSDP2, TP)
 is owned by its device mesh's ranks, with the mesh's shape and placements;
 `iter_full()` yields `full_tensor()` and `iter_local()` yields `to_local()`.
 A `DTensor` with other placements (`Partial`, strided shards) is declared

@@ -1377,6 +1377,32 @@ def test_metadata_agrees_with_both_modes(self):
         for pairs in (source.iter_full(), source.iter_local()):
             assert [(n, t.dtype, tuple(t.shape)) for n, t in pairs] == declared
 
+    @pytest.mark.parametrize("shared_module", [False, True])
+    @pytest.mark.parametrize("mode", ["full", "local"])
+    def test_tied_names_are_transferred_each_round(self, shared_module, mode):
+        """A separate inference stage may require the tied output-head name."""
+        model = torch.nn.Module()
+        model.model = torch.nn.Module()
+        model.model.embed_tokens = _module_with(("weight", torch.zeros(3, 2)))
+        if shared_module:
+            model.lm_head = model.model.embed_tokens
+        else:
+            model.lm_head = torch.nn.Module()
+            model.lm_head.register_parameter("weight", model.model.embed_tokens.weight)
+        source = ModuleSource(model)
+        names = ["model.embed_tokens.weight", "lm_head.weight"]
+
+        for value in (1.0, 2.0):
+            model.model.embed_tokens.weight.data.fill_(value)
+            assert source.metadata == [
+                ParamMeta(name, torch.float32, (3, 2)) for name in names
+            ]
+            pairs = source.iter_full() if mode == "full" else source.iter_local()
+            received = dict(pairs)
+            assert list(received) == names
+            for name in names:
+                torch.testing.assert_close(received[name], torch.full((3, 2), value))
+
 
 @pytest.fixture
 def fake_world():

@@ -304,7 +304,10 @@ def _is_member(param: torch.Tensor) -> bool:
 
 
 class ModuleSource(WeightSource):
-    """`WeightSource` over `module.named_parameters()`: plain, FSDP or DTensor.
+    """`WeightSource` over every parameter name, including tied aliases.
+
+    Inference workers may keep a trainer's tied parameters on different
+    pipeline stages, so each name must be transferred even when storage is shared.
 
     A plain tensor is owned by every rank. A `DTensor` is owned by the global
     ranks of its device mesh, with the mesh's shape and the DTensor's
@@ -324,7 +327,7 @@ def __init__(self, module: torch.nn.Module) -> None:
     @cached_property
     def metadata(self) -> list[ParamMeta]:
         metas = []
-        for name, p in self._module.named_parameters():
+        for name, p in self._module.named_parameters(remove_duplicate=False):
             layout = _dtensor_layout(p)
             if layout is None:
                 metas.append(ParamMeta(name, p.dtype, tuple(p.shape)))
@@ -343,12 +346,12 @@ def metadata(self) -> list[ParamMeta]:
         return metas
 
     def iter_full(self) -> Iterator[tuple[str, torch.Tensor]]:
-        for name, param in self._module.named_parameters():
+        for name, param in self._module.named_parameters(remove_duplicate=False):
             if _is_member(param):
                 yield name, materialize_full_tensor(param)
 
     def iter_local(self) -> Iterator[tuple[str, torch.Tensor]]:
-        for name, param in self._module.named_parameters():
+        for name, param in self._module.named_parameters(remove_duplicate=False):
             if not _is_member(param):
                 continue
             layout = _dtensor_layout(param)
